originalTitle: US Open tennis 2026: Tiafoe beats Medvedev, Alcaraz sees off Paul, Sabalenka and Noskova win on day eight – as it happened
summary: Francis Tiafoe and Carlos Alcaraz progressed with straight-set victories against Daniil Medvedev and Tommy Paul respectively
content: And that’s us done for this session. Stay tuned for Tumaini Carayol’s report from today’s action. Tiafoe has been superb recently, he’s asked why. “I don’t want to put any secrets out,” he says with a laugh. “I’m coming forward and I’m having fun. Put that altogether and you’re in the quarter-finals of the US Open.” Tiafoe is 10-0 on Louis Armstrong. He’s asked about why he loves the venue. “It’s been amazing playing in this court, the energy is amazing. It’s the people’s court,” he says. A brilliant performance from Frances Tiafoe, who looked sound in every aspect of his game today. He will face compatriot Alex Michelsen in the quarters. Tiafoe serves for the match. He sends his first serve long. The second isn’t great but Medvedev finds the net and Tiafoe is through the quarter-finals. A superb backhand from Tiafoe leaves Medvedev sprawling and it’s match point for the American … Tiafoe to serve 4-5 down. Medvedev can only return the first serve into the net and we’re level at 5-5. After a long rally, Tiafoe hits long and Medvedev has set point on his own serve at 6-5. But some superb work at the net, from Tiafoe this time, level the score at 6-6. The New York crowd roar in appreciation. Tiafoe looks to have held serve with a drop shot but some lovely play at the net from Medvedev gives him the mini-break at 4-3. But he can’t consolidate and we’re back on serve again at 4-4. And a double fault from Medvedev kills his momentum and we’re at 2-2 on serve in the tiebreak. He makes it 3-2 before we head to Tiafoe’s serve and a strong serve helps him to 3-3 as we change ends. Medvedev gets the first break of the tiebreak to lead 2-1 and gain a crucial advantage as he attempts to stay in the match. Big Foe has volleyed superbly today, taking advantage of Medvedev’s position behind the baseline – he’s pretty far back now, having spent some time on the paint – to sneak in. He holds to 15, so here comes a potentially decisive breaker … which Tom Lutz will bring you. So it’s goodnight from me, and good evening from him. Tiafoe has handled pressure really well today, holding to 15 to stay in the set at 5-5. And as if to prove how comfy he is out there, a forehand on the run changes the complexion of the rally, then a perfect drop takes him to 15-all. But from there, Medvedev quickly secures his hold; can Tiafoe do likewise and force a breaker? …but Medvedev isn’t having it, serving his way out of immediate danger to lead 5-4 in the third. And then there was one;,Tiafoe leading Medvedev 2-0 4-4, and at 15-30, he has a chance to try and get the match finished… Michelsen is every bit as happy as you’d expect. He’s not dropped a set in the tournament and isn’t “super-surprised” with his progress as he’s been working hard for years. He’s 0-4 against Tiafoe and 0-2 against Medvedev, but if he plays the former it’d probably be on Ashe, a once-in-a-lifetime occasion. At 22, Michelsen reaches his first major quarter-final, in which he’ll face Medvedev or Tiafoe. Michelsen though, plays a really good point, a second serve catching the edge of the service box and a backhand volley bringing us to deuce; a big serve saves him when he’s down advantage. Meantime, Tiafoe hods to love, a pirouette at net helping him find a volley for a ball that’s behind him, obscene behaviour, and he leads 2-0 3-3. A 57-second hold for Medvedev, who trails 0-2 3-2; Michelsen is under pressure serving for the match at 30-40. This is a really excellent performance from Tiafoe – though there were breaks in set one, he’s looked dialled-in throughout and his shot-selection has been very good. But he nets for deuce serving at 2-1, while on Grandstand, Etcheverry holds, meaning Michelsen must serve for the match at 7-6 6-5 5-4. As they are now, Tiafoe making 15-40 then collaring a return lashed down the line; we’re back oin serve in third, the American by two sets to love. Indeed he can. Annoyingly, my coverage drops out, returning in time for me to see that he’s broken for 0-2 2-0, still in this thing and fighting, The problem he has is not really having the weapons to blow opponents away, which means in big matches, things are necessarily difficult for him. I’m really enjoying Tiafoe’s performance today – I like the way he’s mixing it up and taking it to Medvedev, expecting to win. Medvedev, though, holds for 0-2 1-0, then ushers a backhand down the line for a winer and 0-15. Can he parlay the start into something more significant? It looks like we’re getting all-American quarter, Michelsen finding a winner for 30-40, then unleashing a forehand before sealing the break with an overhead. He leads 2-0 3-2, and is three holds away. Both players leave court; on Grandstand, Michelsen leads Etcheberry 2-0 2-2. Brilliant from Tiafoe, making advantage then changing the flow of the next point with a forehand coming in. But there’s work yet to do, an over-the-shoulder backhand volley followed by another, and Armstrong explodes, Big Foe beating his big chest. He leads 7-6 6-4, and Medvedev is in deep trouble. Medvedev holds, forcing Tiafoe to serve for the set, and he controls his emotions well, skipping in to guide a backhand winner down the line for 15-all; a service winner follows. So when a return is netted, he holds two set points, missing the first … and the second, losing patience in a long rally and hitting long. To deuce we go, tension ratcheting up. Lovely from Medvedev who, at 30-all, clobbers a backhand to the corner, then makes space at net to raise break point with a tricky putaway. Tiafoe, though, eager to hang on to his break, finds a service winner followed by an outstanding stooping volley almost from behind him – the return was goodun too – then secures a crucial hold with another gigantic delivery. BF leads 7-6 5-3, a game away from the second set. Tiafoe holds for 7-6 4-2 and this set is progressing much more swiftly that it’s forebear; Medvedev quickly arranges a hold of his own to keep his opponent honest, but he’s running
chineseTitle: 2026 年美国网球公开赛：蒂亚福击败梅德韦杰夫、阿尔卡拉兹击败保罗、萨巴伦卡和诺斯科娃在第八天获胜——事实确实如此
chineseSummary: 弗朗西斯·蒂亚福和卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯分别直落两盘战胜丹尼尔·梅德韦杰夫和汤米·保罗
chineseContent: 这就是我们本次会议的工作。请继续关注图迈尼·卡拉约尔今天的行动报告。蒂亚福最近表现出色，有人问他为什么。 “我不想泄露任何秘密，”他笑着说。 “我挺身而出，我很开心。总而言之，你就进入了美国公开赛的四分之一决赛。”蒂亚福以 10-0 战胜路易斯·阿姆斯特朗。有人问他为什么喜欢这个场地。 “在这个法庭上打球真是太棒了，能量是惊人的。这是人民法庭，”他说。弗朗西斯·蒂亚福 (Frances Tiafoe) 表现出色，今天比赛的各个方面看起来都很出色。他将在四分之一决赛中对阵同胞亚历克斯·米歇尔森。蒂亚福为本场比赛发球。他的一发发球很长。第二场比赛表现不佳，但梅德韦杰夫进球，蒂亚福晋级四分之一决赛。蒂亚福的一记精彩反手让梅德韦杰夫倒地不起，美国选手蒂亚福的发球局以4-5落后到了赛点。梅德韦杰夫只能将一发球回网，我们以5-5平。经过长时间的对攻后，蒂亚福长打得手，梅德韦杰夫在自己的发球局中以6-5拿下局点。但这次蒂亚福的网前表现出色，将比分追成6-6。纽约人群欢呼雀跃。蒂亚福看似凭借一记吊球保住了发球局，但梅德韦杰夫在网前的精彩表现让他在4-3时取得了小破发。但他无法巩固状态，我们以4-4再次发球。梅德韦杰夫的双误破坏了他的势头，抢七局我们将比分追成2-2。在我们接蒂亚福的发球局之前，他将比分改写为3-2，而当我们换场时，他的强力发球帮助他将比分改写为3-3。梅德韦杰夫在抢七中率先破发，以2-1领先，并在试图继续比赛的过程中获得了关键优势。大敌今天利用梅德韦杰夫的位置截击得非常出色
